snippet.title: Trackastrophe! - Official Developer Deep Dive Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Developer Deep Dive Trailer for Trackastrophe!, a puzzle train strategy game developed by Kinoko Studio. Players will navigate a train through vibrant locales by laying down tracks to reach the destination. Trackastrophe! is available now on PC (Steam).
